tool_signatures.name: AbortError
tool_signatures.description: Execute AbortError

tool_signatures.name: batch_screenshots
tool_signatures.description: Create a batch screenshot job for multiple URLs (1-50). Returns immediately with a job ID. Use get_batch_status to poll for results (wait 2-5 seconds between polls). All URLs share the same screenshot options. Each URL consumes one credit; failed URLs get credits rolled back.

tool_signatures.name: check_screenshot_cache
tool_signatures.description: Check if a screenshot is already cached without capturing a new one. Does not count against your quota. Pass the same parameters you would use for take_screenshot so the cache key matches correctly.

tool_signatures.name: createBatchJob
tool_signatures.description: Submit up to 50 URLs for batch screenshot processing. Returns immediately with a job ID. Poll GET /v1/screenshot/batch/{jobId} for results. Each URL consumes one credit; failed URLs get credits rolled back automatically.

tool_signatures.name: createWebhook
tool_signatures.description: Register a webhook URL to receive event notifications. Max 5 webhooks per account. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the returned secret.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint URL for webhook delivery

tool_signatures.name: create_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Create a webhook subscription for event notifications. Events: screenshot.completed (batch job done), quota.warning (80% used), quota.exceeded (100% used), capture.completed and change.detected (scheduled captures). Max 5 webhooks per account. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256. Save the returned secret to verify signatures.

tool_signatures.name: deleteWebhook
tool_signatures.description: Remove a webhook. Future events will no longer be delivered to this URL.

tool_signatures.name: delete_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Delete a webhook subscription by ID. This cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: extractContentGet
tool_signatures.description: Extract structured content from any web page. Supports 6 extraction types: markdown (readable content via Readability), text (plain text), html (raw HTML), article (structured with title/author/excerpt), links (all page links), metadata (OG tags, title, description). Uses query parameters for GET requests.

tool_signatures.name: extractContentPost
tool_signatures.description: Extract structured content from any web page using a JSON body. Supports the same 6 extraction types as GET. POST is recommended for programmatic use as it accepts native JSON types.

tool_signatures.name: extract_content
tool_signatures.description: Extract content from a web page. Returns structured data based on the extraction type. Supports: markdown (readable content), text (plain text), html (raw HTML), article (structured with title/author/excerpt), links (all page links), metadata (OG tags, title, description).

tool_signatures.name: getBatchJobStatus
tool_signatures.description: Poll the status of a batch screenshot job. Returns current progress and download URLs for completed items. Download URLs are presigned and valid for 24 hours.

jobId.description: The batch job ID returned by POST /v1/screenshot/batch

tool_signatures.name: getDailyUsage
tool_signatures.description: Returns daily screenshot counts for the past N days. Useful for monitoring usage trends and building dashboards.

days.description: Number of days to look back (1-90)

tool_signatures.name: getScreenshotInfo
tool_signatures.description: Check if a screenshot is cached and get metadata without capturing. Does not count against quota. Useful for checking if a URL has been recently captured.

url.description: The URL to check cache status for

format.description: Output format to check (cache keys are format-specific)

width.description: Viewport width in pixels (cache keys are resolution-specific)

height.description: Viewport height in pixels (cache keys are resolution-specific)

tool_signatures.name: getUsage
tool_signatures.description: Returns screenshot usage statistics for the current billing period including plan name, period dates, and remaining credits.

tool_signatures.name: get_batch_status
tool_signatures.description: Get the status of a batch screenshot job. Poll this until status is

tool_signatures.name: get_usage
tool_signatures.description: Get current month

tool_signatures.name: healthCheck
tool_signatures.description: Check API health including Chromium, Redis, and database connectivity. No authentication required.

tool_signatures.name: listWebhooks
tool_signatures.description: List all webhooks for the authenticated account.

tool_signatures.name: list_webhooks
tool_signatures.description: List all webhook subscriptions on your account. Returns webhook IDs, URLs, subscribed events, and creation dates.

tool_signatures.name: renderSignedUrl
tool_signatures.description: Renders a screenshot using a pre-signed URL. No API key required. The URL must have been generated via POST /v1/screenshot/sign. Expired URLs return 410 Gone, tampered URLs return 403 Forbidden.

tool_signatures.name: signScreenshotUrl
tool_signatures.description: Creates a pre-signed URL that captures a screenshot when visited. The signed URL can be used without an API key, making it ideal for embedding in emails, documents, or sharing with third parties. Signing is free and does not count against your quota. Each render of the signed URL consumes one credit. URLs are tamper-proof and expire after the specified duration.

url.description: URL to capture (must be http or https)

expires_in.description: URL validity in seconds (default: 86400 = 1 day, max: 2592000 = 30 days)

tool_signatures.name: sign_screenshot_url
tool_signatures.description: Generate a signed URL for a screenshot that can be used without an API key. Useful for embedding screenshots in emails, documents, or sharing with third parties. Signing is free, rendering the URL consumes one credit. URLs expire after the specified duration.

tool_signatures.name: takeScreenshot
tool_signatures.description: Takes a screenshot of any URL and returns it as a binary image or JSON with base64 data URI. Set response_type=json for AI agent integrations. Supports device emulation, dark mode, ad blocking, cookie banner removal, and caching.

url.description: The URL to capture (must be http or https)

format.description: Output image format. Use png for lossless quality, jpeg/webp for smaller files, pdf for documents.

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport

quality.description: Image quality for JPEG and WebP (1-100). Ignored for PNG and PDF.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before capturing. Useful for pages with animations or lazy-loaded content.

dark_mode.description: Emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark CSS media feature

block_ads.description: Block advertisements and trackers for cleaner screenshots

block_cookie_banners.description: Remove cookie consent banners and GDPR overlays

device.description: Device preset for mobile/tablet emulation. Sets viewport size, user agent, and device scale factor.

hide_selectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to hide before capturing (e.g., '.banner,.popup')

click_selector.description: CSS selector to click before capturing (e.g., to dismiss a modal or expand content)

user_agent.description: Custom user agent string to use for the request

cache.description: Use cached result if available. Set to false to force a fresh capture.

cache_ttl.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds (max depends on plan). Default: 86400 (24 hours).

response_type.description: Response format. 'binary' returns raw image bytes with Content-Type header (default). 'json' returns a JSON object with a base64 data URI in the 'image' field — recommended for AI agents, ChatGPT Actions, and programmatic integrations.

tool_signatures.name: takeScreenshotPost
tool_signatures.description: Takes a screenshot and returns it as a binary image or JSON with base64 data URI. Accepts a JSON body with exactly one of: url (capture a website), html (render raw HTML), or markdown (render Markdown with a styled template). All screenshot parameters (format, width, height, dark_mode, etc.) work with all three sources. Use POST when providing html or markdown content. Supports device emulation, dark mode, ad blocking, cookie banner removal, and caching.

url.description: URL to capture (mutually exclusive with html and markdown)

html.description: Raw HTML content to render (max 2MB, mutually exclusive with url and markdown)

markdown.description: Markdown content to render with styled template (max 500KB, mutually exclusive with url and html)

tool_signatures.name: take_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Capture a screenshot of a website URL, raw HTML, or Markdown content. Provide exactly one of: url, html, or markdown. Returns the image as a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Supports device emulation (iPhone, Pixel, iPad), dark mode, ad blocking, cookie banner removal, full-page capture, and custom viewports.

tool_signatures.name: testWebhook
tool_signatures.description: Send a test payload to a webhook URL to verify it's working correctly.

tool_signatures.name: test_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Send a test payload to a webhook endpoint to verify it receives events correctly. Returns the delivery status and HTTP response code.
